Section 7. Cancellation. Customer may cancel this Agreement at any time
upon thirty (30) days' written notice to Provider. Early termination fees
apply if cancelled within the first twelve (12) months: a fee equal to
three (3) months of the then-current subscription fees.

Section 8. Data return. Upon cancellation, Provider will make Customer

response_text:
The cancellation policy described in the service agreement is as follows:

- **Cancellation Period**: Customers may cancel the agreement at any time by providing **thirty (30) days' written notice** to the Provider.
- **Early Termination Fees**: If the cancellation occurs within the **first twelve (12) months** of the subscription, a fee equal to **three (3) months of the then-current subscription fees** will apply.
- **Data Return**: Upon cancellation, the Provider will make the **Customer Data available for export for ninety (90) days**.

This policy ensures a grace period for cancellation and outlines the associated fees and data retention period.
